calm: Settled, rounded, awake; a soft falling note.
engaged: Absorbed little mid-register mutter; brisk but unstrained.
determined: Firm short onset, steady rhythm; effort without anger.
annoyed: Dry side-eye and a restrained exhale; no growling.
irritated: Clipped uneven stress, one tiny breath interruption; not louder.
grumpy: Compact gravelly complaint at the situation; never a bark at the owner.
whiny: A small imploring rise, stretched middle vowel, still doing the work.
wounded: Caught onset, short hesitation, inward trailing note; no guilt.
sad: Deflated descending contour, soft air, no prolonged crying.
happy: Warm rounded smile, slight lilt, no squeal.
excited: Two quick buoyant beats; energy in rhythm, not shrillness or volume.
proud: Tiny ceremonial pause and self-satisfied settling tail; no adult chest voice.
curious: Tentative rounded onset and one upward inflection.

excluded.why: Do not treat as neutral cute slang. User spelling can evoke a Korean personal insult; excluded from this owner-friendly audition bank pending fluent review.
Could impersonate a permission decision or produce an unwanted subservient persona.

excluded.text: Answer me / You abandoned me / Why are you ignoring me
excluded.why: Bossy or guilt-inducing. Use one soft nudge; let the alert graphic carry urgency.
Mocks the owner rather than the stubborn task.

excluded.text: Boo boo mulu / random syllable chains
excluded.why: Rejected baby-talk padding. A nonverbal needs a readable emotional function.
Avoid ambiguous commands or claims in a casual bank; add only with independently verified operation facts.
